bugs.bug: bats_execute runs commands with PATH="$BATS_SAVED_PATH" without requiring it to be set, so if BATS_SAVED_PATH is unset the command runs with an empty PATH and fails with 'date: no such file or directory'
bugs.example: common.bash: PATH="$BATS_SAVED_PATH" "$@" silently sets PATH to the empty string when BATS_SAVED_PATH is unset, so internal calls such as date cannot be found instead of failing fast with a clear message
